domain: Echelon 3 Core Infrastructure and Ecology / Assets/_Project/Scripts/World / DestructibleOrganicManager.cs

fixedFindings.problem: Corpse-resource nodes used the low 32 bits of a 64-bit tombstone hash as the runtime node id. A zero low half made the node unresolvable, and an active 32-bit collision could make a fauna consume call drain a different corpse than the target returned by the nearest-node query.
fixedFindings.fix: Added non-zero id fallback through the high hash half and bounded active-node collision probing with deterministic FNV-style remixes. The selected replacement slot is ignored during collision checks so weakest-node overwrite stays legal.

fixedFindings.problem: Regrowth/decomposition/maturation and spore/harvest audio owner paths still carried textual value constructors (`new float2`, `new HarvestAudioEvent`, `new SporeAcousticEvent`) even though no managed heap allocation occurs. Prior strict hot scans treat these tokens as ambiguity.
fixedFindings.fix: Replaced `float2` construction with default+field helpers and changed private audio event structs to default-filled stack values before queue insertion.

buildVerification.blockedReason: AGENTS.md forbids dotnet build/Roslyn when CPU is above 50%. Workspace root also has no Unity-generated .csproj files, so dotnet build would stop before C# source compilation.
